name: Review
description: What AI apps and coding agents changed in your vault that you haven't looked at yet, file by file, like a pull request: who changed it and when, the diff against the text before, and Keep or Revert. A count in the status bar and a line in a changed file's header lead there. From Activity (who changed what) and File history (the text before).

header.label: Review in changed files' headers
header.description: a Review button at the top of a file an AI changed, with who changed it and when

skip.label: Folders not to review
skip.description: AI changes to files in these folders don't wait for you (an agent's own notes, its logs)
